name: Soyuz TMA-11
about: Soyuz TMA-11 (2007-045A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMA), launched 2007 Oct 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2007 Oct 11), held fixed
docked to S25544; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
